findings.title: Withholding and claimed needlessness reinforce one another
findings.claim: The two focus predicates form a self-reinforcing closure: withholding what should circulate is joined to treating that closure as evidence that no outside relation is needed.
findings.mechanism: The focus form بَخِلَ carries unjustified withholding, while ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ carries the core of claimed absence of need; their coordination under one subject makes the hand's closure and the independence claim mutually legible.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see one interacting posture rather than two unrelated faults: possession is kept closed, and the closed possession supplies the story of independence.
findings.containment: The packet supports coordination and reinforcement, not a one-way causal order. The ordinary readings of both predicates remain intact, and no claim is made that every use of either root has this relation.

epistemic.reason: The citable cross-run publication is trusted and directly anchors both focus word occurrences and both accepted focus branches.
